patthana18.13:1.1: Hetuñceva hetusampayuttañca hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetu ceva nahetuvippayutto ca nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṃkhittaṃ.) Hetuyā ekaṃ…pe… avigate ekaṃ.
patthana18.13:2.1: Hetusampayuttañceva na ca hetuṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetuvippayutto ceva nana ca hetu nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṃkhittaṃ.) Hetuyā ekaṃ…pe… avigate ekaṃ. (Saṃkhittaṃ.)
